newsitem.title: JAPAN: Agency sees normal Japan temperatures in Feb-April.
newsitem.headline: Agency sees normal Japan temperatures in Feb-April.

text.p: Temperatures are forecast to be about normal throughout Japan during the three months from February to April, the Meteorological Agency said on Monday.
Snowfall in areas along the Sea of Japan coast is also expected to be at normal levels, the agency said in its latest three-month weather forecast.
In February, regions facing the Pacific Ocean are likely to see much sunshine, while many cloudy, snowy or rainy days are forecast for areas along the Sea of Japan coast, it said.
Temperatures and rainfall were both expected to be normal during the month.

In March, areas along the Pacific Ocean are likely to see more sunny days than is normal for the period, while coastal regions facing the Sea of Japan are expected to see a good deal of cloudy, snowy or rainy weather, the agency said.
Temperatures are expected to be below normal.
Rainfall is forecast to be below normal in northern, eastern and western areas along the Pacific, but normal in other parts of Japan.
April is likely to see normal temperatures and rainfall throughout Japan, the agency said.
